data.body: Provisional candidate register. C01 defines a documentation taxonomy and ownership policy. C02 adds context-aware punctuation, diction, and paragraph checks. C03 expands comment hygiene across maintained formats and removes citation-only historical exemptions. C04 reduces README.md to client onboarding. C05 separates client and developer paths in the documentation index. C06 corrects operation-certificate guidance around DSSE envelopes and SSHSIG. C07 corrects import idempotency, batching, push, and recovery guidance. C08 completes CLI option and command discovery while coordinating with active registry work. C09 fixes MCP summary extraction and environment metadata drift checks. C10 corrects adoption templates, demonstrations, and agent skills. C11 narrows the user guide to supported client workflows. C12 splits configuration guidance by audience and corrects stale links or future plans. C13 corrects identity setup and exempt type names. C14 marks JIRA_PROJECT as required and adds workflow preflight. C15 reduces Jira sync setup to operator actions and supported limitations. C16 replaces the plan guide with a concise workflow and verified example paths. C17 narrows support and security policies to their external purposes. C18 makes CONTRIBUTING.md canonical and reduces AGENTS.md plus the first-change guide to audience-specific constraints and pointers. C19 aligns the ChatGPT guide on validation and import troubleshooting. C20 rewrites architecture, event schema, and concurrency documentation around current Python seams. C21 repairs ADR links, statuses, supersession, and generated index metadata. C22 moves completed plans, transcripts, and implementation history to tickets or ADRs. C23 keeps exit-code documentation focused on current behavior. C24 fills public library docstring and reuse-surface gaps. C25 corrects stale Jira backend narration. C26 reduces production comments and docstrings to current rationale and invariants. C27 normalizes prompts, schemas, routing data, and evaluation specifications without changing contracts. C28 remediates diagnostics, logs, audit UI text, and demonstration output while preserving structured fields. C29 reduces workflow, infrastructure, and configuration comments to current operational rationale. C30 rewrites test comments around protected invariants while preserving wording fixtures. C31 separates experiment procedure from results and preserves immutable evidence with provenance. C32 removes ornamental dividers and comments that duplicate code after manual review. C33 refocuses MCP authentication, S3, and Gerrit setup documents on their operator audiences. C34 audits package metadata, templates, and remaining integration examples for accuracy and audience fit. Every item remains provisional until exploration and filtering finish. No project files changed.
